message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine relation between two yes/no questions.

Question1: "A vacinação contra Covid-19 deve ser obrigatória para crianças de 6 meses a 5 anos?" (Should Covid-19 vaccination be mandatory for children aged 6 months to 5 years?)

Question2: "A vacinação contra a COVID-19 deve ser obrigatória para crianças?" (Should Covid-19 vaccination be mandatory for children?)

Question2 is broader: for children (presumably all ages). Question1 is specific to age 6 months to 5 years. Are they equivalent? No, because the scope differs. If you answer yes to Q1 (mandatory for 6 months-5 years) does not necessarily answer Q2 (mandatory for all children). Could be yes for that group but maybe no for older children. So they are different questions. So classification: DIFFERENT.

Thus JSON with relation "DIFFERENT" and brief reasoning.
